title: Anyone experiencing extreme levels of real (non-digital) synchronicities in their lives should take a look at the show called strange angel about the early days of our space program and it’s relation to Aleister Crowley’s religion thelema.
content: Just a warning it’s quite dark and disturbing at times but it is unfortunately based on reality. It also happens to be produced in part by Ridley Scott. Edit: Also look into the concept of the “revelation of the method” and pay attention to what ideas are being pushed into pop culture at particular times.
